title: Battery
description: Charge, status, health, temperature and voltage

actions.label: Battery status
actions.command:
dumpsys battery | awk -F': ' '/^ +level:/{l=$2} /^ +temperature:/{t=$2/10} /^ +voltage:/{v=$2} /^ +health:/{h=$2} /^ +status:/{s=$2} /powered: true/{p=$1; sub(/^ +/,"",p); sub(/ powered/,"",p)} END{split("unknown charging discharging not-charging full",S," "); split("unknown good overheat dead over-voltage failure cold",H," "); printf "Charge       %s%%
Status       %s
Power        %s
Health       %s
Temperature  %.1f °C
", l, S[s], (p==""?"battery":p), H[h], t; if(v>100) printf "Voltage      %.2f V
", v/1000; else if(v>0) printf "Voltage      %s V
", v}'
